hero.heading: Begin Your Child's Triumph Story

steps.title: Campus Visit

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.description: Fill out the online enquiry form below. Our admissions team will reach out within 48 hours.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.description: Early Years: a playful classroom observation. Primary & above: the Trium Spark assessment.

steps.title: Offer & Enrolment
steps.description: Selected families receive an offer letter and are guided through a smooth onboarding process.

form.heading: Enquire Now
form.subheading: Fill in your details and our admissions team will get in touch within 48 hours.

items.question: What is the age criterion for Early Years?
items.answer: Children aged 3–6 years are eligible for our Early Years programme (Nursery to KG). The child must turn 3 by June 1st of the admission year.

items.question: What documents are required for admission?
items.answer: Birth certificate, previous school report card (if applicable), passport-size photographs, and address proof. Our team will share a complete checklist after your enquiry.

items.question: Is there a registration fee?
items.answer: Yes, a non-refundable registration fee is applicable at the time of form submission. Details are shared during the campus visit.

items.question: Do you offer transport facilities?
items.answer: Yes, we provide school bus services covering major areas of Nashik. Route details and fees are available from our admissions office.

items.question: Can I visit the campus before applying?
items.answer: Absolutely. We encourage all prospective families to schedule a campus tour. You can request a visit through the enquiry form or by calling our admissions office.
